1.query: How many albums has Rahman released?
1.sql: SELECT s2.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM songs s1 JOIN singers s2 ON s1.song_id = s2.song_id GROUP BY s2.name ORDER BY cnt DESC, s2.name ASC LIMIT 10
